title: Q10
description:
Read: Jos 21:43-45, Gen 15:13-16

Not a word failed, and they possessed the land. The same promise had named four hundred years of affliction before that possession.

a) These all died not having received the promise, after a book that says not a word failed. What promise is left?

b) They were not to be made perfect apart from us. What does that do to a perfection their own victories did not reach?
